title: StockSmart Logistics Schedule — Route Delivery Allowance Days in a Consigned Bin's Reorder Point
content:
**StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program — reorder point of a new consigned bin that takes over an item taken out of one of the customer's VendPoint machines.**

The route truck deliveries the service level of the program's ship-to schedules each week add allowance days to the reorder point: no route deliveries add 2 days, 1 or 2 a week add 1 day, and 3 or more add none; a ship-to whose service level is not on record adds none.

The figure is the route deliveries per week of the service level held by the program's ship-to as a Ship-To Fulfillment Account.

| Route deliveries a week | Allowance days |
|---|---|
| 0 | 2 days |
| 1 or 2 | 1 day |
| 3 or more | none |
| service level not on record | none (read as 7 deliveries a week) |

Hypothetical boundary: a ship-to scheduling 2 route deliveries a week adds 1 day; one scheduling 3 adds none.
